Method of Attack: Compromising SOHO routers to build a covert data transfer network
Using infected routers as launchpads to further compromise U.S. critical infrastructure entities
Proxying malicious traffic through routers, firewalls, and VPN devices to evade detection
Impacted Systems: U.S. territorial government entity in Guam
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in SOHO router web management interfaces (WMIs)
Compromise of devices at the edge of networks
Use of default insecure configurations in routers
Indicators of Compromise: Compromised SOHO routers used as botnet nodes
Targeting of Netgear ProSAFE firewalls, Cisco RV320s, DrayTek Vigor routers, Axis IP cameras
